meta.name: Aoashi Season 2
meta.description: Aoi Ashito’s game has now earned him a spot on the A team, but he is quickly overwhelmed by his harsh new reality. Surrounded by elite players like Kuribayashi and Akutsu, practices are just as merciless as the matches. In this U-18 Premier League of powerhouse talent, Ashito must evolve or be crushed, if he’s ever to be acknowledged. (Source: Crunchyroll)
